title: Touchpad + key seems to not work in parallel
body:
### Tested versions

- reproductible in Godot 4.3

### System information

Linux Fedora 41, RTX 3060

### Issue description

I simply added a plane, and make working a simple character (capsule, camera linked to the neck)

This works, but take a look inside the `_input` method:

```gdscript
extends CharacterBody3D

@onready var head: Node3D = $head

const SPEED := 30
const JUMP_VELOCITY := 4.5
const mouse_sens := 0.4

func _ready() -> void:
	Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED)

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	print(event) # displays the event only when I dont touch any key
	if event is InputEventMouse:
		rotate_y(-deg_to_rad(event.relative.x * mouse_sens))
		head.rotate_x(-deg_to_rad(event.relative.y * mouse_sens))
		head.rotation.x = clamp(head.rotation.x, deg_to_rad(-89), deg_to_rad(89))

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	# Add the gravity.
	if not is_on_floor():
		velocity += get_gravity() * delta

	# Handle jump.
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_accept") and is_on_floor():
		velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY

	var input_dir := Input.get_vector("left", "right", "up", "down")
	var direction := (transform.basis * Vector3(input_dir.x, 0, input_dir.y)).normalized()
	
	if direction:
		velocity.x = direction.x * SPEED
		velocity.z = direction.z * SPEED
	else:
		velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, SPEED)
		velocity.z = move_toward(velocity.z, 0, SPEED)

	move_and_slide()
```

What happens is:

- if I press "up" to walk, it is OK
- if I press "up" and "left" or "right" together, it's OK, I walk in diagonal
- if I drag my finger on the touchpas with no key pressed, the camera (neck and character) are rotating
- **if I press a movement key (up, down, left, right) + touchpad, no rotation is done.**

The `print(event)` isn't executed.


### Steps to reproduce

Open the provided example on a laptop with touchpad

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[bugtouchpad.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18464967/bugtouchpad.zip)
